_comment: Candidate monsters DESIGNED BY THE MONSTERS AGENT, not yet in the game. Each is generated on PixelLab as an 8-direction base (create-character-v3, from scratch, zero animations) and tagged MONSTER_CANDIDATE — never MONSTER, which is the shipping roster's ground truth. The maintainer reviews the 8 directions in the wiki; an APPROVED candidate is retagged MONSTER and only then gets its five animated states. `size` stays <= 176: measured over the 57 shipped monsters plus the maintainer's two references, 1 px/px density holds through 184 and degrades from ~236 (storm_shellback at 256 is the reference 'zoomed' case). Prompts are high-detail on purpose (maintainer 2026-09-09: low detail confuses the model — it cannot tell what is what). Prompts never name a facing or a background: v3 rotates a south sprite and always renders transparent.

candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.prompt: Stocky flightless fantasy bird with a barrel chest, thick scaly yellow legs ending in hooked black talons, a heavy hooked beak, a tall crest of stiff feathers in teal, crimson and gold, barred brown-and-cream wing feathers, and a long fan of iridescent rainbow tail plumes.
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to hide. It settles every dispute with its talons, and it looks for disputes.
candidates.attack_action: Talon Rake - Hops up off both legs, throws its wings out wide for balance and rakes both hooked talons down and forward through the air in one hard swipe, then drops back onto its feet
candidates.attack_extreme: Crest Flare Rake - Hurls itself forward with the crest snapped up, both talons raking down hard, loose feathers flying

candidates.name: Stonewing
candidates.prompt: Fantasy gargoyle shown full body from head to feet, grey weathered stone skin, a horned bestial face with a fanged snarl, glowing red eyes, bat-like wings folded tightly against its back, clawed hands, and crouching legs.
candidates.lore: It kept watch from the chapel eaves for centuries. When the last bell fell silent, it came down.

candidates.name: Foxfire
candidates.prompt: Fantasy fox spirit with pale cream fur, three bushy tails tipped with blue flame curled around its body, glowing blue eyes, red markings on its face, and small blue flames floating around it.
candidates.lore: Three tails, three lies, and one truth it will tell you for a price you will not like.

candidates.name: Dapplekin
candidates.prompt: Young fantasy forest deer spirit with soft dappled fawn-brown fur, pale spots that glow faintly green, two small antler buds wrapped in moss, large dark gentle eyes, slender legs, and small white flowers growing along its back.
candidates.lore: Born where the old stag fell. The forest watches over it, and takes offence on its behalf.

candidates.name: Cinderkit
candidates.prompt: Small fantasy fire fox kit with dark ash-grey fur, glowing orange ember patterns along its back and tail, bright amber eyes, large ears tipped with small flames, and a fluffy tail curled around its paws.
candidates.lore: A fox born in the ash beds. It is warm to the touch and will not be held.

candidates.name: Stiltwing
candidates.prompt: Fantasy marsh heron standing tall shown full body from crest to feet, slate-grey feathers with a black crest, wings folded tightly, a long sharp yellow beak, one pale watchful eye, and long thin legs, standing on nothing, no water and no ground beneath it.
candidates.lore: It stands in the reeds for hours without a breath. Whatever moves beneath the water is already chosen.

candidates.name: Dunekit
candidates.prompt: Small fantasy desert cat kit with pale sand-coloured fur, oversized ears, large green eyes, faint dark stripes on its legs, and a tufted tail wrapped around its paws.
candidates.lore: Grown cats of the dunes wear the sun as armour. This one has not yet, and hides from it in the noon shade.

candidates.name: Deepclaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cave bear with pale hairless grey skin over heavy muscle, no eyes only smooth skin where eyes would be, a wide nose and long yellow fangs, enormous black claws, and pale fungus growing along its spine.
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and hunts without needing to. In the deep galleries it smells a torch before the torch is lit.

candidates.name: Gulo
candidates.prompt: Adult wolverine with realistic proportions, thick dark brown fur with a pale band along the flanks, a broad head with small ears, a snarling muzzle of sharp teeth, heavy claws and a bushy tail held low.
candidates.lore: Small enough to be mistaken for prey and strong enough to drive a bear off a kill. It has done both.

candidates.name: Frostyak
candidates.prompt: Massive shaggy yak with realistic proportions, long matted black-brown wool crusted with frost, two wide sweeping horns sheathed in ice, a heavy head with steaming nostrils, and thick short legs.
candidates.lore: It crosses the high passes in weather that kills men. The herds are gone; this one still walks the route alone.

candidates.name: Duskplate
candidates.prompt: Fallen knight shown full body from head to feet, realistic proportions, black steel plate armor scored with old cuts, a closed great helm with a narrow slit, a tattered black surcoat with a defaced crest, a longsword held upright and a kite shield.
candidates.lore: He kept his oath after his lord broke it, and now the oath is all that is left of him.

candidates.name: Hornmaul
candidates.prompt: Minotaur shown full body from head to feet, realistic proportions, a massive bull's head with wide curved horns and a ring through the nose, dark brown hide over enormous muscle, a leather harness, cloven hooves, and a double-headed axe held low at its side.
candidates.lore: The maze was built around it, not for it. It knows every turn, and it is always one turn behind you.
candidates.walk_action: walk loop seen head-on, full walk cycle in place, the near leg swings forward and plants while the far leg pushes off behind, the legs clearly crossing past each other, the massive shoulders rocking side to side and the head dipping with each step, hooves lifting off the ground, seamless loop whose last frame leads straight back into the first, no turning

candidates.name: Blackhorn
candidates.prompt: Aurochs bull with realistic proportions, a huge black-brown body, a heavy neck hump, long forward-curving horns with pale tips, a broad head with small dark eyes, and thick legs with dark hooves.
candidates.lore: The last of the wild herd, and it knows it. It charges anything that crosses the meadow, and the meadow is wide.

candidates.name: Sandsting
candidates.prompt: Small desert scorpion with realistic proportions, a pale sand-yellow armored body, two pincers held close, a segmented tail curled over its back ending in a dark stinger, and eight short legs.
candidates.lore: It hides in boots and bedrolls. The sting is small; the fever it brings is not.
candidates.attack_action: Tail Sting - Whips the curled tail up over its head and drives the stinger straight down in front of it
candidates.attack_simple: Pincer Snap - Throws one pincer wide open and snaps it shut

candidates.name: Palewick
candidates.prompt: Floating spectral lantern of black iron with tall narrow panes, a cold pale blue flame inside shaped like a gaunt hooded face, a rusted chain hanging beneath it, and thin trails of freezing mist.
candidates.lore: It was carried into the mine and came back alone. The light it gives leads only one way.

candidates.name: Grimimp
candidates.prompt: Small gargoyle-like imp shown full body from horns to feet, realistic proportions, dark grey stone-like hide, two curved black horns, narrow burning orange eyes, a mouth of small sharp teeth set in a hard line, bat-like wings folded tight, clawed hands and feet.
candidates.lore: The gargoyles' lesser kin, cut from the same stone. It sits in the eaves and drops on whatever passes beneath.

candidates.name: Pitjaw
candidates.prompt: Giant antlion larva with realistic proportions, a broad flattened sand-brown armored body, a wide head with two enormous curved serrated jaws held close together, small black eyes, six short digging legs tucked beneath, and sand grains caught in its plates.
candidates.lore: It digs the pit and lies beneath the floor of it. The sand slides, and whatever stood on the slope goes down to the jaws.

candidates.name: Urchling
candidates.prompt: Round deep-purple sea urchin the size of a fist walking on the tips of its short blunt spines, a tight dome of overlapping plates underneath, pale tube feet reaching out between the spines and wet sand stuck across its underside
candidates.lore: The tide put it down and went away without it. It has been walking inland ever since, very slowly.

candidates.name: Helmcrab
candidates.prompt: Hermit crab that has taken a rusted iron helmet for a shell, its soft spotted abdomen curled up inside the dome, one big pale claw blocking the eye slot, jointed legs braced underneath and stalked eyes raised over the brow of the helm
candidates.lore: It chose the helmet for the fit, not the history. Something else wore it out of the sea.

candidates.name: Driftbone
candidates.prompt: Hunched body built of sea-smoothed driftwood limbs bleached grey-white and wedged together, knotted rope lashing the joints, crusts of barnacles and dried weed along its back, sand running steadily out of the gaps between the timbers
candidates.lore: Everything the sea gave back, standing in the order it washed up. It does not go near the water.

candidates.name: Whelkspire
candidates.prompt: Large knobbed whelk shell carried on a thick muscular grey foot, the spire chalk-white and drilled with old boreholes, a horny brown operculum hanging beside the mouth like a shield and two short eye stalks out over the rim
candidates.lore: It drills the shell of anything slower than itself, which is most things. It takes a whole day and it does not hurry.

candidates.name: Peatling
candidates.prompt: Small squat figure packed together out of wet black peat and fine root hair, glossy with bog water, two pale flat stones set in for eyes, short thick arms held close and the straight cut marks of a turf spade still down its body
candidates.lore: Cut out of the bank and never carried away. It puts itself back every time the water takes a piece.

candidates.name: Turfstack
candidates.prompt: Low squat stack of cut black peat turves drying in a compact block with every edge tucked inside its own outline, the bricks crumbling at the corners, pale dried grass roots showing along their edges, walking on the bottom two turves, no tools and nothing protruding
candidates.lore: Stacked to dry by somebody who meant to come back for it. It has done its own drying and it is ready to be burned.

candidates.name: Mudnewt
candidates.prompt: Big pale bog newt with dark olive mottling over soft translucent skin, three pairs of feathery scarlet external gills behind its head, stubby splayed toes, a flattened swimming tail curled beside it and milky lidless eyes
candidates.lore: It breathes the bog through its gills and the bog has been breathing back. It is bigger every year.

candidates.name: Pitchergut
candidates.prompt: Cluster of fat carnivorous pitcher plants grown from one thick root foot, each trumpet veined deep maroon over green with a hooded lid raised, slick wet rims, drowned flies floating in the fluid inside and fine stiff hairs down the throats
candidates.lore: It drinks whatever falls in, and it has learned what falls in most. It leans toward warmth.

candidates.name: Withyman
candidates.prompt: Man-shaped cage woven from bog willow withies, the weave tight across the chest and loose at the limbs, packed inside with black mud and reed, and a smiling mask of stitched brown hide lashed to the top where a head should be
candidates.lore: Woven around nothing, on purpose, by somebody. It is the one thing here that was built rather than left.

candidates.name: Quagmaw
candidates.prompt: Low hunched body of peat and black water with a wide round sinkhole opening in its front like a mouth, broken reed stems standing in the rim like teeth, water draining steadily inward and down, wet mud sliding off its back
candidates.lore: The ground opens where it walks and closes behind it. What it takes goes down further than the bog does.

candidates.name: Screeback
candidates.prompt: Standing heap of loose grey scree, flat shards of shale stacked and sliding over one another, a shoulder line of larger slabs, grit pouring continuously from its joints and two dark gaps for eyes deep between the plates
candidates.lore: The slope it came off is still missing a piece. It rebuilds itself out of whatever is underfoot.

candidates.name: Flintjaw
candidates.prompt: Body of grey flint split open down the front, the chalky white cortex on the outside and the glassy black core showing as a jagged mouth of knapped flakes, razor curved edges, and a crude hand axe shape worked into its brow
candidates.lore: Somebody knapped a tool out of its face a long time ago. The edges it has now, it made itself.

candidates.name: Platecurl
candidates.prompt: Armoured millipede coiled flat into a tight spiral, overlapping grey-black plated segments ridged down the back, dozens of short legs folded away underneath, short antennae tucked in and a hard blunt head plate at the centre of the coil
candidates.lore: It uncoils only to move and only to eat. Stone dust is most of its diet and it has worn grooves in the road.

candidates.name: Quernjaw
candidates.prompt: Pair of round grinding quern stones set one on the other and standing on a squat base, the upper stone turning slowly against the lower like a jaw, a broken wooden handle stub in its rim, fine white grain dust caught in the cut grooves
candidates.lore: It ground for a household that is not there. It goes on turning and it is not particular about what goes in.

candidates.name: Boneshale
candidates.prompt: Upright slab of grey layered shale with a fossil skeleton weathering out of it, the pale stone bones standing proud of the surface in a curled sleeping shape, the slab cracked along its bedding planes and rock dust falling where the bones flex
candidates.lore: It was a shape before this was stone. The stone is the only part of it that is still here.

candidates.name: Rockface
candidates.prompt: Boulder with a heavy face carved into one side by an old hand, deep brow, chiselled eyes, a mouth cut straight and wide, the tool marks still crisp and packed with moss, and the rest of the stone left completely unshaped
candidates.lore: Somebody cut a face into it to be looked at by. Only the face moves, the rest is still a rock.

candidates.name: Snowgrouse
candidates.prompt: Plump ptarmigan in full winter plumage, pure white feathers with a black eye stripe, wings folded tight to its rounded body, heavily feathered feet like snowshoes and a short black bill, crouched low against the wind
candidates.lore: It is white all winter and it does not know when winter ends here. It breaks cover at the last possible moment.

candidates.name: Snowlip
candidates.prompt: Slab of wind-packed snow standing on end with a curled overhanging lip at the top, deep blue shadow under the curl, a hard crust of rime along its windward face and fine spindrift pouring continuously off its edge
candidates.lore: It is the piece of the ridge that was about to fall. It has been about to fall for a long time now.

candidates.name: Rimebeard
candidates.prompt: Figure grown entirely of hoarfrost needles over a dead branch armature, feathery white crystal spines standing out from thin black wood, glittering facets across it, and a hollow dark space where the frost has not filled in
candidates.lore: It grew out of one night of cold on something that was already dead. Warm breath takes pieces off it.

candidates.name: Thawborn
candidates.prompt: Crouching body of grey slush and meltwater holding its shape, everything the snow kept all winter suspended visible inside it, a mitten, a bootlace, small bones, a tin lid, and cold water running steadily out of its feet
candidates.lore: The thaw gives back what the snow was keeping, in one piece, walking. It comes down the mountain every year.

candidates.name: Moraine
candidates.prompt: Vast ridge of glacial rubble risen into a hulking body, mixed boulders, grit and dirty grey ice compacted together, a house-sized granite erratic riding on one shoulder, brown meltwater streaming out of its base
candidates.lore: The ice pushed it ahead of itself for a thousand years and then let go. It is still going in the same direction.

candidates.name: Icefall
candidates.prompt: Frozen waterfall risen off the cliff, fused columns of blue-white ice forming a heavy hunched body, running water still visible moving inside the ice, frozen spray standing out from its shoulders and a cracked hollow core
candidates.lore: The water inside it never stopped. It is the loudest thing on the mountain and it only speaks in thaw.

candidates.name: Pumicekin
candidates.prompt: Small lump of pale grey pumice full of gas holes, so light it half hops with each step, two pinpricks of orange light glowing deep inside its pores, sharp broken edges and fine ash dust shaking loose from it
candidates.lore: It came out of the mountain in the air, not the ground. It weighs almost nothing and it is nearly impossible to catch.

candidates.name: Basaltkin
candidates.prompt: Body of fused hexagonal basalt columns, black and glassy on the facets, snapped off at different heights along its shoulders, the joints ringed with fine horizontal fracture lines and red heat glowing in the deepest cracks
candidates.lore: It cooled into these shapes on its own, in straight lines, without being cut. The mountain does this and nobody knows why it is neat.

candidates.name: Ashfall
candidates.prompt: Standing drift of warm grey volcanic ash holding a crouched shape, the surface smooth and floury, and pressed into its flank the clean printed impressions of leaves, a bird and a hand left by things that fell in it
candidates.lore: It settled over everything that was there in one afternoon. The prints in it are not of anything that is still here.

candidates.name: Cindermask
candidates.prompt: Figure of cracked charcoal held together by the heat inside it, orange light showing through every fissure, flakes of grey ash lifting off it and settling back, and a smiling mask of fine white ash over the front of its head
candidates.lore: It burned and kept the shape it burned in. Pieces come off it and it does not notice.

candidates.name: Riftmaw
candidates.prompt: Huge wedge of split black rock walking on knuckles of stone, a glowing lava fissure running the full height of its body from crown to foot, molten rock dripping slowly from the crack and heat haze bending the air around it
candidates.lore: The mountain opened here and the opening walked away. The crack in it has never closed and never widened.

candidates.name: Whitegill
candidates.prompt: Blind cave salamander with translucent pink-white skin showing the organs faintly underneath, three pairs of feathery scarlet gills behind the head, a long flattened tail curled beside it, thin pale legs and two blank covered eye spots
candidates.lore: It has never needed eyes and it does not have them. It knows the shape of the water it is in perfectly.

candidates.name: Moonmilk
candidates.prompt: Body of soft white cave moonmilk, a wet paste like wet chalk holding a hunched shape, finger marks pressed into its surface where something touched it, thick drips hanging off its underside and a cold pale sheen
candidates.lore: It takes a print from anything that touches it and keeps it. Some of the prints on it are very small.

candidates.name: Sinterstep
candidates.prompt: Stack of mineral sinter terraces from a warm spring, rimmed shallow pools stepped up its body and still holding water, banded orange, white and rust across every lip, steam drifting off its shoulders
candidates.lore: Warm water built it a step at a time on its way down. The pools on it are still the right temperature.

candidates.name: Goodguest
candidates.prompt: Hollow figure in a clean host apron and long coat, hands folded neatly in front of it, head inclined in a slight bow, a smiling mask of pale wood for a face, and one arm extended to the side as if showing the way
candidates.lore: It steps aside to let you go first, every time. Hearn said it asked politely, and he is the only one who came back up.

candidates.name: Facewall
candidates.prompt: Slab of cave wall walking on two stone stubs, with human faces pushing out of the rock from inside it, all of them smiling, some fully formed and some only a brow or a mouth emerging, the stone stretched thin over them
candidates.lore: The faces come further out the longer you look at it. None of them are finished and all of them are the same one.

candidates.name: Thinning
candidates.prompt: Figure that has nearly finished thinning, its middle still solid grey cloth and skin, its edges unresolved and see-through, one hand faded away entirely at the wrist, all colour bleached out toward the outline
candidates.lore: It is most of the way to the Quiet and it has stopped going. Standing near it is cold in a way that is not temperature.

candidates.name: Listener
candidates.prompt: Tall hollow figure in heavy grey cloth with no mask at all, its head a smooth blank oval, both hands raised and cupped behind where ears would be, leaning forward slightly
candidates.lore: It has no face because it is not for being looked at. It leans in when you speak and it does not miss anything.

candidates.name: Holemaw
candidates.prompt: Enormous hunched mass of cave rock in a body shape, with a perfectly round black opening where a face should be, smooth smiling masks fused into its shoulders and back like scales, and both stone hands cupped open and empty in front of it
candidates.lore: The hole under the mountain, standing up. It is new, and the oldest here say the worst part is who it has to be.

candidates.name: Deeplure
candidates.prompt: Fantasy deep-sea anglerfish with a bulbous dark grey body, an oversized hinged jaw crowded with long glass-clear teeth, a drooping fleshy lure on a stalk over its brow with a pale glowing tip, small milky eyes, and tattered fins.
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and does not believe in it. The light it carries is the only one it trusts.

candidates.name: Abyssroll
candidates.prompt: Giant fantasy deep-sea isopod with overlapping pale bone-white armour plates like a woodlouse, seven pairs of jointed legs tucked beneath it, short segmented antennae, and small blind black eyespots.
candidates.lore: It eats what falls and is never in a hurry. Everything reaches the bottom eventually.

candidates.name: Barbmantle
candidates.prompt: Fantasy deep squid with a dark violet barbed mantle, eight short arms held close beneath it, two longer hunting tentacles coiled tight against its body, rows of hooked suckers, and large gold-ringed eyes.
candidates.lore: It hunts by patience and takes hold with hooks. Nothing it has caught has ever been recovered.

candidates.name: Chamberkin
candidates.prompt: Fantasy nautilus with a tightly coiled cream and rust-banded shell, a crown of short pale tentacles at the opening, a thick leathery hood folded over them, and two simple dark eyes.
candidates.lore: Older than the reefs it drifts over, and built in rooms it has already left behind.

candidates.name: Shockdisc
candidates.prompt: Fantasy electric ray, a flat round slate-grey disc of a body with a short thick tail, small eyes set high on top, pale blue voltage lines crawling across its back, and a soft cream underside.
candidates.lore: It lies flat under the sand and charges quietly. The water tells you when you are too close.

candidates.name: Cloakray
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy devil ray with enormous dark wings folded down around itself like a closed cloak, two horned cephalic fins curling forward beside a wide mouth, pale underside markings, and a thin whip tail curled close.
candidates.lore: It passes over like weather. The shoals go quiet long before anything sees it.

candidates.name: Driftbell
candidates.prompt: Small fantasy jellyfish with a ribbed translucent pale blue bell, a faint glow inside the dome, short frilled oral arms gathered beneath it, and fine trailing tentacles held close.
candidates.lore: It goes where the cold water goes and has no say in the matter. It glows when it is touched.

candidates.name: Ghostcuttle
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cuttlefish with a broad mantle fringed by a rippling fin, eight short arms held together beneath, two W-shaped pupils in gold eyes, and bands of colour running down its flanks.
candidates.lore: It changes its skin faster than you can decide what you saw. Whatever it was, it is not there now.

candidates.name: Lobefin
candidates.prompt: Fantasy coelacanth with thick steel-blue armoured scales flecked with white, heavy lobed fins set on fleshy muscular stalks, a blunt stubborn head, and small hard eyes.
candidates.lore: It was old before the first coast was drawn. It has changed nothing about itself since.

candidates.name: Rockgill
candidates.prompt: Fantasy stonefish, a lumpy mottled brown ambusher encrusted with algae and grit, a wide upturned mouth set in a permanent scowl, small high-set eyes, and a row of venomous dorsal spines.
candidates.lore: It is a stone until the moment it is not. Most of what steps on it never learns the difference.

candidates.name: Saltmariner
candidates.prompt: Fantasy drowned sailor shown full body from head to feet, bloated grey-green flesh, a waterlogged dark coat hanging heavy, barnacles crusting one shoulder and jaw, pale clouded eyes, and strands of weed in its hair.
candidates.lore: It still walks the deck watch it was set. The ship is somewhere below and it has not been relieved.

candidates.name: Reefjaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy reef shark with a stout grey body and white belly, a blunt rounded snout, heavy pectoral fins held wide, black unblinking eyes, and a slightly open jaw showing ragged triangular teeth.
candidates.lore: It does not hunt so much as arrive. The reef knows the shape of it and empties.

candidates.name: Slimeknot
candidates.prompt: Fantasy knot of hagfish wound into one writhing mass of pale grey eel-like bodies, slime sheeting off the coils in strands, blind slit mouths ringed with small rasping teeth.
candidates.lore: It arrives as one thing and leaves as many. What it finishes with is clean to the bone.

candidates.name: Hollowgulp
candidates.prompt: Fantasy gulper eel curled tight on itself, an enormous black pelican-like jaw far larger than its thin whip of a body, loose dark skin, tiny eyes set far forward, and a faint luminous tail tip.
candidates.lore: Almost all of it is mouth. What little is left exists to carry the mouth somewhere useful.

candidates.name: Cloakmantle
candidates.prompt: Fantasy vampire squid with webbed dark red arms drawn up over itself like a closed umbrella, pale spines lining the inside of the web, large red eyes visible in the fold, and two small fins on its mantle.
candidates.lore: It folds itself shut and waits out whatever is passing. It has outwaited everything so far.

candidates.name: Lurecaller
candidates.prompt: Fantasy drowned siren shown full body, a pale long-haired figure with fused finned legs, gill slits along the ribs, webbed hands with dark claws, hollow black eyes, and a mouth open on no sound.
candidates.lore: The song is not for you. You are only what answered it, and it does not stop for that.

candidates.name: Stonemoray
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy moray eel wedged among rocks, a thick muscular mottled green-brown body in a tight S-curve, a long jaw held agape on inward-pointing glassy teeth, small hard eyes, and a low dorsal ridge.
candidates.lore: It holds one hole in the reef and has never needed another. The reef has grown around it.

candidates.name: Shieldcrab
candidates.prompt: Fantasy horseshoe crab with a smooth domed olive-brown shield, a jointed rear plate, a long rigid tail spine held straight behind, many small legs hidden beneath the rim, and two pairs of simple eyes on the shell.
candidates.lore: It has walked the same shallows since before the shore had a name. It has not been improved on.

candidates.name: Clamjaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy giant clam with a thick fluted blue-grey shell parted on a rippling turquoise mantle, a row of small dark eyespots along the mantle edge, and pale grit and weed on the outer shell.
candidates.lore: It closes on whatever reaches inside and has nowhere else to be. It can wait longer than you can.

candidates.name: Mudhopper
candidates.prompt: Fantasy mudskipper with a mottled brown body, bulging periscope eyes set on top of its head, muscular pectoral fins propping it upright, a wide mouth, and a spiny dorsal fin raised.
candidates.lore: It left the water on purpose and comes back only when it has to. It watches the tide like a debt.

candidates.name: Gnarlshell
candidates.prompt: Fantasy adult snapping turtle with a ridged algae-bearded dark shell, a thick scaled neck, a hooked beak, small fierce eyes, heavy clawed feet, and a long saw-toothed tail.
candidates.lore: It does not retreat into its shell because it has never had to. Everything else moves instead.

candidates.name: Bluecleaver
candidates.prompt: Fantasy blue lobster with a deep cobalt armoured body, one oversized crusher claw and one narrower cutter claw held forward, long antennae swept back over its shell, and stalked black eyes.
candidates.lore: One claw is for breaking and one is for cutting. It has never been observed using the wrong one.

candidates.name: Kelpwader
candidates.prompt: Fantasy humanoid shown full body from head to feet, built of braided brown kelp and grey driftwood with small shells knotted into the strands, hollow dark eye sockets, water streaming from its limbs.
candidates.lore: It gathers what the tide leaves and stands it upright. Some of what it gathers used to walk.

candidates.name: Barkbull
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy bull sea lion with a thick-necked barrel body on heavy flippers, a coarse mane over the shoulders, a scarred chest, a blunt whiskered muzzle open on a roar, and small dark eyes.
candidates.lore: It holds one stretch of beach and counts everything on it as its own, including the noise.

candidates.name: Divebeetle
candidates.prompt: Fantasy great diving beetle seen from above, a smooth oval black carapace rimmed with gold, fringed paddle legs held out to the sides, short antennae, and a glossy domed head.
candidates.lore: It carries its own air down with it and comes up only when that runs out.

candidates.name: Hushwing
candidates.prompt: Fantasy great owl perched upright, wings folded tight, a broad pale facial disc, soft mottled grey and brown plumage, large amber eyes, a small hooked beak, and feathered feet gripping stone.
candidates.lore: It arrives without a sound and leaves the same way. The field only knows afterwards.

candidates.name: Prismtail
candidates.prompt: Fantasy peafowl-like bird standing upright, an iridescent blue-green neck, a crest of thin spines, wings folded close, and a long closed tail train of eyed feathers held low behind it.
candidates.lore: It is the loudest thing in the meadow and the hardest to see. Both are on purpose.

candidates.name: Redcrest
candidates.prompt: Fantasy large parrot perched upright, a crimson crest raised, teal and cobalt flight feathers folded to its body, a heavy curved pale beak, a white eye ring, and grey gripping feet.
candidates.lore: It repeats what it hears in the voice it heard it in. People have learned to be careful near it.

candidates.name: Bladefoot
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cassowary standing upright, glossy black hair-like plumage, a bare blue neck with red wattles, a tall bony helmet casque, wings folded invisibly, and a long dagger claw on each inner toe.
candidates.lore: It asks for nothing and gives no warning. The claw does the only talking it needs.

candidates.name: Mirecrane
candidates.prompt: Fantasy tall crane standing upright, wings folded against a pale grey body, a long neck drawn back into an S, a straight spear-like bill, a red crown patch, and long dark legs.
candidates.lore: It stands in the shallows until it is part of them, then strikes once without bending.

candidates.name: Gallowcrow
candidates.prompt: Fantasy oversized raven perched upright, glossy black plumage, shaggy throat hackles, wings folded tight, a heavy black bill, and one pale knowing eye.
candidates.lore: It keeps count of the fields it visits and comes back in the right order. Nobody taught it that.

candidates.name: Rimefowl
candidates.prompt: Fantasy ptarmigan in full winter white, plumage puffed against the cold, feathered feet, a small black bill, a black stripe through the eye, and wings folded invisibly into its body.
candidates.lore: It vanishes by standing still. In summer it is a different bird and knows it.

candidates.name: Reedstalker
candidates.prompt: Fantasy bittern standing upright with its neck stretched straight up, streaked brown and cream plumage, wings folded flat, a long dagger bill pointed skyward, and yellow eyes turned forward.
candidates.lore: It becomes a reed when watched and a bird when not. It is patient enough for both.

candidates.name: Duskhang
candidates.prompt: Fantasy fruit bat perched upright, large leathery wings furled around itself like a cloak, a fox-like face with big dark eyes, tall ears, and long clawed thumbs hooked over the ledge.
candidates.lore: It hangs where the orchard ends and takes its share first. It has never been caught taking twice.

candidates.name: Bloodwing
candidates.prompt: Fantasy vampire bat crouched forward on its folded wing knuckles, a grey-brown body, a fleshy leaf-shaped nose, small sharp ears, exposed white incisors, and dark blood on its lower jaw.
candidates.lore: It takes a little from many and is gone before morning. The herd wakes up merely tired.

candidates.name: Jewelback
candidates.prompt: Fantasy stag beetle seen from above, an iridescent emerald and gold carapace, large mandibles held closed in front, short elbowed antennae, and six jointed legs tucked close to the body.
candidates.lore: The jaws are for other beetles, not for you. It will still close them on a finger.

candidates.name: Bonepicker
candidates.prompt: Fantasy carrion beetle seen from above, a matte black carapace banded with burnt orange, short clubbed antennae, spined legs folded beneath it, and a small hard head.
candidates.lore: It finds the dead before the crows do and buries them where only it can find them again.

candidates.name: Duskmoth
candidates.prompt: Fantasy moth at rest with broad grey and cream wings folded flat in a roof over its back, a thickly furred thorax, large feathered antennae, and small dark eyes.
candidates.lore: It is drawn to lit windows and cannot explain why. It has never harmed the lamp or itself.

candidates.name: Twigcase
candidates.prompt: Fantasy caddisfly larva inside a case it has built from short twigs and grit bound together, only its dark head and two clawed forelegs reaching out of the open end.
candidates.lore: It builds its house from the riverbed and carries it. Everything it owns is glued on.

candidates.name: Glassnymph
candidates.prompt: Fantasy mayfly nymph with a flattened translucent amber body, three feathered tail filaments, feathery gills fringing its sides, six slim legs, and two dark eyes.
candidates.lore: It spends a year under a stone for one evening in the air. It does not seem to mind the trade.

candidates.name: Coalback
candidates.prompt: Fantasy fire beetle seen from above, a soot-black shell cracked through with glowing orange heat lines, short thick legs, blunt antennae, and a faint shimmer of heat over its back.
candidates.lore: It nests in the warm rock and takes the heat with it when it leaves. The nest cools within hours.

candidates.name: Scalewader
candidates.prompt: Fantasy fish-folk warrior shown full body from head to feet, overlapping blue scales, finned forearms and calves, gill slits at the ribs, a broad flat-eyed head, and a bone-tipped spear held upright.
candidates.lore: It holds the shallows the way a border is held. It has never once come further up the beach.

candidates.name: Bluecoil
candidates.prompt: Fantasy banded sea snake coiled on itself, glossy blue-black rings along a slim body, a flattened paddle tail, a small blunt head held level, and dark unblinking eyes.
candidates.lore: It comes ashore only to rest and has no interest in anything it cannot swallow whole.

candidates.name: Slagsmith
candidates.prompt: Fantasy forge goblin shown full body from head to feet, green-grey skin, a scorched leather apron over a squat muscular frame, heavy iron tongs gripped in one fist, and molten orange light across its face.
candidates.lore: It smelts whatever is brought to it and asks no questions about where the metal came from.

candidates.name: Bellowsback
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy crucible golem shown full body from head to feet, a furnace of a torso with bellows lungs at its back, a crust of black slag over glowing seams, and rivers of bright silver running in the cracks.
candidates.lore: It was built to keep a fire and has kept one since. Nobody living remembers lighting it.

candidates.name: Brushkit
candidates.prompt: Fantasy fox kit with russet fur and a cream chest, oversized ears and paws, a thick brush tail curled around its feet, a black nose, and watchful amber eyes.
candidates.lore: Too young to hunt well and too proud to admit it. It follows the older ones at a careful distance.

candidates.name: Digclaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy badger with a low muscular body over short legs, coarse grey fur, a broad black and white striped head, small dark eyes, and heavy pale digging claws on the forefeet.
candidates.lore: It gives ground to nothing and has the scars to prove the policy works.

candidates.name: Tuftear
candidates.prompt: Fantasy lynx with thick smoke-grey fur, black tufts standing from its ears, long ruffed cheeks, enormous padded feet, a short black-tipped tail, and pale green eyes.
candidates.lore: It crosses deep snow without sinking and arrives where nothing was watching.

candidates.name: Scytharm
candidates.prompt: Fantasy praying mantis with a slender green body, folded raptorial forearms lined with spines held up in front, a triangular head turned to one side, large compound eyes, and wings closed flat along its back.
candidates.lore: It holds its arms as if praying and has never once been mistaken for harmless twice.

candidates.name: Elderscute
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy tortoise with a high domed shell of thick scutes worn smooth, wrinkled grey column legs, a long neck, a hooked beak, and old heavy-lidded eyes.
candidates.lore: It has outlived the forest twice and shows no sign of having noticed either time.

candidates.name: Meadowcoil
candidates.prompt: Fantasy grass snake coiled in a low spiral, a slim olive body with a pale yellow collar behind the head, fine dark barring along the flanks, and a small head resting on its own coils.
candidates.lore: It would rather leave than bite and plays dead when leaving is not an option.

candidates.name: Whiskerjaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy giant catfish with a flat wide slate-grey head, long trailing barbels around a broad mouth, tiny eyes set far apart, smooth scaleless skin, and low soft fins.
candidates.lore: It lives where the river is darkest and takes whatever the current brings it, whole.

candidates.name: Leatherdead
candidates.prompt: Fantasy bog body risen and shown full body from head to feet, skin tanned to dark brown leather stretched over bone, braided red hair, a twisted rope still knotted at its throat, and sunken empty eyes.
candidates.lore: The bog kept it exactly as it was left. It has come back with the same intentions.

candidates.name: Bellowfrog
candidates.prompt: Fantasy enormous bullfrog with a warty olive-green back, a pale spotted underside, a swollen throat sac, gold-ringed bulging eyes, and thick muscular hind legs folded beneath it.
candidates.lore: Its call carries across the whole fen and stops every other sound in it.

candidates.name: Mireshrew
candidates.prompt: Fantasy water shrew with dense dark velvet fur beaded with water, a long pink pointed snout, tiny black eyes, small hidden ears, and stiff silver swimming hairs fringing its feet.
candidates.lore: It must eat almost constantly or die, which explains the temper on something that small.

candidates.name: Bogcoil
candidates.prompt: Fantasy swamp python wound in a heavy coil, a thick olive body with black saddle markings, a broad wedge head held low, heat pits along the upper lip, and dull unblinking eyes.
candidates.lore: It takes one meal a season and spends the rest of the year digesting it in the same spot.

candidates.name: Marshlight
candidates.prompt: Fantasy will-o-wisp, a cold pale green flame hovering above the water with the faint suggestion of a drowned face inside it, trailing small sparks, and a soft halo of mist.
candidates.lore: It leads travellers off the path with a light that looks like a window. It never looks back.

candidates.name: Mudpiper
candidates.prompt: Fantasy small wading bird standing upright, speckled brown and cream plumage, wings folded close, a long slightly curved probing bill, thin dark legs, and a bright round eye.
candidates.lore: It runs the tideline all day reading it like a page and never looks up at what is watching.

candidates.name: Silteel
candidates.prompt: Fantasy swamp eel half out of the silt, a thick smooth brown body without scales, a wide grim mouth, tiny eyes set high, and a low fin ridge running down its back.
candidates.lore: It breathes air when the pool dries and crosses mud to find the next one.

candidates.name: Denmother
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy cave bear with a massive domed skull, a high shoulder hump of muscle, shaggy dark brown fur, a scarred muzzle, small deep-set eyes, and long claws worn blunt by stone.
candidates.lore: The cave is hers and always has been. Everything else in it is a guest or a meal.

candidates.name: Palegill
candidates.prompt: Fantasy blind cave salamander with translucent pink-white skin showing faint organs beneath, feathery red external gills behind the head, four thin legs, and smooth skin grown over where eyes would be.
candidates.lore: It has never needed light and does not register it. The dark is simply where things are.

candidates.name: Stonehop
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cave cricket with a humped pale brown back, enormously long thin antennae swept back over its body, folded powerful jumping legs, and small dark eyes.
candidates.lore: It jumps before it knows what startled it and lands somewhere it has never been.

candidates.name: Grubsnout
candidates.prompt: Fantasy mole with dense black velvet fur, broad pink spade-like forepaws turned outward, a fleshy pink star-shaped snout, no visible eyes, and a short bare tail.
candidates.lore: It reads the whole field through its nose and has never once seen the sky.

candidates.name: Stonecoil
candidates.prompt: Fantasy rock python coiled on warm stone, a heavy tan body with dark grey blotches, a broad flat head, deep heat pits along the upper lip, and vertical-slit gold eyes.
candidates.lore: It lies on the sun-warmed rock all day to pay for one night of hunting.

candidates.name: Palehand
candidates.prompt: Fantasy troglodyte shown full body from head to feet, a stooped pallid humanoid with loose grey skin, huge lidless colourless eyes, long groping fingers, flat blunt teeth, and no hair anywhere.
candidates.lore: It has lived so long without light that it now hunts by the sound of breathing.

candidates.name: Stonecreep
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cave centipede curled in a tight arc, armoured red-brown segments each with a pair of pale legs, long rear antennae, and a dark head with venom claws folded beneath it.
candidates.lore: It comes out of the crack in the wall in one motion, as if the wall had decided something.

candidates.name: Boreworm
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy tunnelling worm with a thick ringed grey segmented body, a circular boring mouth of grinding stone-coloured plates, bristles along each segment, and no eyes at all.
candidates.lore: It makes the tunnels everything else lives in. It does not know they are there.

candidates.name: Palefin
candidates.prompt: Fantasy blind cave fish with a colourless smooth body showing pink beneath, skin grown over empty eye sockets, thin translucent fins, and fine sensory lines along its flanks.
candidates.lore: It maps the pool by pressure alone and knows the shape of every stone in it.

candidates.name: Driftcat
candidates.prompt: Fantasy snow leopard with thick pale smoke-grey fur patterned in dark rosettes, an enormously long thick tail curled around its paws, small round ears, and pale green eyes.
candidates.lore: It follows the herds up the passes and is never seen until it has already chosen.

candidates.name: Whitebrush
candidates.prompt: Fantasy arctic fox in full winter coat, dense pure white fur, short round ears, a small black nose, dark eyes, and a thick tail wrapped around its feet.
candidates.lore: It follows the big hunters at a distance and lives on what they leave behind.

candidates.name: Shaggyhorn
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy musk ox with a long shaggy dark brown skirt of hair hanging to the hooves, a broad boss of fused pale horns curving down and out, a low heavy head, and steam at its nostrils.
candidates.lore: It stands into the storm rather than turn from it, and the storm gets tired first.

candidates.name: Glacierworm
candidates.prompt: Fantasy ice worm with a pale segmented body under a translucent rime crust, a ring mouth of blue-black hooks, faint blue light within the segments, and frost forming along its length.
candidates.lore: It moves through solid ice the way others move through water, and leaves the hole behind it.

candidates.name: Tuskdrift
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy bull walrus with an immense wrinkled brown bulk on broad flippers, two long yellowed tusks, a heavy whiskered muzzle, small bloodshot eyes, and a scarred hide.
candidates.lore: It owns the floe it is lying on and settles the question with its face.

candidates.name: Floepup
candidates.prompt: Fantasy seal pup lying on ice, soft white natal fur, enormous dark wet eyes, small dark nostrils, short foreflippers tucked under its chest, and fine whiskers.
candidates.lore: It waits where it was left and calls at intervals. The calling carries a long way.

candidates.name: Rimemoth
candidates.prompt: Fantasy winter moth at rest with broad pale blue-white wings folded flat over its back and frost gathered along the wing edges, a thickly furred white thorax, and feathered antennae.
candidates.lore: It flies in weather that grounds everything else, and only after dark.

candidates.name: Hoarfisher
candidates.prompt: Fantasy ice fisher spirit shown full body from head to feet, a hunched figure wrapped in frozen stiffened rags, a barbed fishing spear held upright, hollow black eye sockets, and rime across its shoulders.
candidates.lore: It still works the hole it cut and will share the catch. Nobody has ever accepted.

candidates.name: Snowvole
candidates.prompt: Fantasy snow vole sitting up on its haunches, a round body in thick pale grey fur, small ears nearly buried, black bead eyes, a blunt nose, and tiny pink forepaws held together.
candidates.lore: It tunnels under the snow all winter and comes up only where it means to.

candidates.name: Palegiant
candidates.prompt: Gigantic fantasy snow giant shown full body from head to feet, a shaggy white pelt over massive shoulders, blue-grey weathered skin, a flat brutal brow, small deep eyes, and huge bare hands.
candidates.lore: It comes down with the worst weather and goes back up when the weather does.

candidates.name: Slagcrab
candidates.prompt: Fantasy crab of cooled volcanic slag, a crust of black basalt over its shell, joints glowing molten orange between the plates, heavy blunt claws, and small ember eyes on short stalks.
candidates.lore: It walks out of the vents when they cool and goes back in when they do not.

candidates.name: Glassting
candidates.prompt: Fantasy obsidian scorpion with plates of black volcanic glass, a raised segmented tail ending in a molten orange barb, open serrated pincers, and six small red eyes on a flat head.
candidates.lore: Every plate on it came out of the same flow. It has never left the rock it cooled on.

candidates.name: Cinderbore
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cinder worm with a ribbed ashen-grey body split by glowing ember seams, a rasping ring mouth of dark plates, smoke trailing from its segments, and no eyes.
candidates.lore: It eats the hot rock and leaves the cold. The tunnels it abandons are safe, eventually.

candidates.name: Cellarrat
candidates.prompt: Fantasy cellar rat with coarse grey-brown fur, a long naked pink tail curled beside it, small clever forepaws held up, round dark eyes, and pink translucent ears.
candidates.lore: It knows every gap in the floor and which one the cat cannot follow it into.

candidates.name: Raftercreep
candidates.prompt: Fantasy house spider with long jointed brown legs gathered tight beneath it, a banded pale and dark abdomen, a low cephalothorax, and eight small dark eyes in two rows.
candidates.lore: It has lived in the same corner for years and considers the room an arrangement it allows.

candidates.name: Sootwraith
candidates.prompt: Fantasy chimney wraith shown full body, a figure of hanging soot and grey ash loosely holding a human shape, two dull coal-red eyes, and fine black smoke pouring off its shoulders and hands.
candidates.lore: It comes down the flue when the fire is left to die and stands where the warmth was.

candidates.name: Silverdart
candidates.prompt: Fantasy silverfish seen from above, a tapered body of overlapping metallic silver scales, three long tail filaments, two long antennae, and small dark eyes.
candidates.lore: It lives in the dark behind the skirting and is gone the instant a lamp is lit.
